verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026. Stored in this run (Irish Statute Book PDFs): the Act as enacted (Number 31 of 2026), now the official_url, which gives the title, the number, the date of passing (21 July 2026), the enacting formula and section 1(2) (commencement by ministerial order); S.I. No. 403 of 2026, the Commencement Order; and S.I. No. 404 of 2026, the Establishment Day Order, which appoints 31 July 2026 as the establishment day. Stored on 11 Oct 2026: the AI Office of Ireland's news item on the Act and its CEO (aioffice.gov.ie, the previous official_url, an announcement), which backs the notes on the CEO, the board and further legislation; and the Department of Enterprise, Tourism and Employment's EU AI Act page (the secondary source), which gives 2 Aug 2026 as the date the AI Office was established and lists the Article 77 authorities.

changes.official_url: the record pointed at the AI Office's news item, an announcement; the Act as enacted (Irish Statute Book, ELI) is now stored and becomes official_url (rule 7c)

judgment.status_reasoning: Section 1(2) leaves commencement to ministerial order. S.I. No. 403 of 2026 appoints 31 July 2026 for the whole Act except paragraphs (a) and (e) of the definition of 'applicable market surveillance authority' in section 78; no stored order commences those. 31 July 2026 is before today (18 Oct 2026): Partially in force, date_in_force 2026-07-31.
judgment.scope_reasoning: National law implementing the EU AI Act: in, with no note.
judgment.secondary_url_reasoning: secondary_url stays the Department's EU AI Act page, which backs the notes on 2 Aug 2026 and the Article 77 authorities.
